achievements.name: A Fort Of My Own
achievements.desc: Upgrade all buildings in Fort Forinthry to Tier 3.
achievements.tip: Upgrade all buildings in Fort Forinthry to tier 3.

achievements.name: A Place For My Heads
achievements.desc: Mount all three of the Raptor's slayer trophies.
achievements.tip: Mount all three of the Raptor's slayer trophies inside of the Guardhouse at Fort Forinthry.

achievements.name: A Reptile's Dysfunction
achievements.desc: Upgrade Zorgoth's ring by completing rituals at the Ungael ritual site.
achievements.tip: Upgrade Zorgoth's ring into Zorgoth's soul ring by completing rituals at the Ungael ritual site with it equipped.

achievements.name: Absolute Planker
achievements.desc: Upgrade your plank box to hold 100 of each plank.
achievements.tip: Upgrade their plank box to hold 100 of each plank. This requires a total of 500 contract credits earned while doing Construction Contracts. The plank box costs 50 contract credits, the first upgrade costs 150 contract credits and the second upgrade costs 300 contract credits. These can all be bought from the Estate Agents Shop.

achievements.name: Abyssal Shortcut
achievements.desc: Unlock the asylum gate and complete the shortcut to the abyssal portal.
achievements.tip: Unlock the asylum gate in the Senntisten Asylum, and open the shortcut to the lower level of the asylum.

achievements.name: Almost as Perky as a Prawn
achievements.page: Almost as Perky as a Prawn
achievements.desc: Unlock all the Prawn Perks from your Aquarium.
achievements.tip: Unlock all of the Prawn Perks from the Aquarium in their player-owned house. Once the player has unlocked all perks, they can unlock the achievement by interacting with the prawnbroker and selecting the 'Prawn perks' option.

achievements.name: An Essential Accessory
achievements.desc: Create an expansive essence pouch. Start by buying a hungry hood from Wizard Rinsit's Runecrafting Shop.
achievements.tip: An Essential Accessory is an achievement that requires creating an expansive pouch. It requires level 105 Runecrafting and 95 Divination to make, and temporary skill boosts cannot be used.

achievements.name: Ancient Eastern Tortle Portals
achievements.desc: Activate all tortle portals on The Islands That Once Were Turtles.
achievements.tip: Activate all three tortle portals on The Islands That Once Were Turtles, requiring a total of 100 ancestral energy.

achievements.name: Annihilator
achievements.desc: Earn 'the Annihilator' title by fighting all four nihil at once.
achievements.tip: Obtain [Name] the Annihilator title by defeating all four nihil at once in the Pit in Freneskae as a boss fight during or after Fate of the Gods. If engaged after the quest, players must engage them by selecting "Yes - replay the boss fight!" while standing in the middle of the room. Players must be engaged in combat with all four nihil before defeating them or the achievement will not be completed.

achievements.name: Bag of Herbs
achievements.desc: Purchase the herb bag and the herb bag upgrade from the Herby Werby reward shop.
achievements.tip: Purchase and upgrade the herb bag from the Herby Werby Reward Shop requiring a total of 400 spirit points/potent herbs which require the player to play Herby Werby at least four times and gain the maximum score (100) while doing so. Players can use a Distraction & Diversion reset token (weekly) to reset the distraction and diversion to do it one more time per week per token.

achievements.name: Balanced Combat Triangle
achievements.desc: Solve a lockbox puzzle.
achievements.tip: Solve a lockbox puzzle. Using a lockbox skipping ticket will not work.

achievements.name: Bandos's Memories
achievements.desc: Recover all 14 of Bandos's memories on Yu'biusk.
achievements.tip: Fill Bandos's Memories by collecting an additional 13 Bandos chronicles after The Mighty Fall.

achievements.name: Bane Tuner
achievements.desc: Unlock the spell: Tune Bane.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Tune Bane spell during or after Ritual of the Mahjarrat.

achievements.name: Bean There, Done That
achievements.desc: Purchase the following upgrades from the farmers' market reward shop.
achievements.tip: Purchase all listed farm upgrades in the Farmers' Market at Manor Farm.

achievements.name: Bean There, Done That, Got the Postcard
achievements.page: Bean There, Done That, Got the Postcard
achievements.desc: Purchase the following upgrades from the Anachronia farmers' market reward shop.
achievements.tip: Purchase all farm upgrades in the Farmers' Market at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm on Anachronia.

achievements.name: Big Chinchompa
achievements.desc: Score 1,111 in a session of the Big Chinchompa minigame.
achievements.tip: Score at least 1,111 competence points in a single round of Big Chinchompa. Upon reaching a score of 1,111, the achievement is completed, so players do not need to finish the encounter.

achievements.name: Bill & Ben's Egg/Salon Joint Venture
achievements.desc: After Extinction quest, 'eggs'plore Prehistoric Potterington's (sunny)-side-(up) hustle.
achievements.tip: Complete the six achievements listed below, which may be completed around Anachronia dinosaur farm after completion of the Extinction quest.

achievements.name: Bipedal Mask
achievements.desc: Construct a Tuska mask (mask parts are dropped by airut during their Slayer task).
achievements.tip: Construct a Tuska mask out of a Tuska mask headpiece, Tuska mask lower tusks, Tuska mask upper tusks, Tuska mask plate and Tuska mask top which can be obtained as drops from airut.

achievements.name: Bridge over Fremmy Waters
achievements.desc: Complete all the unabridged Fremennik Sagas.
achievements.tip: Finish all five unabridged Fremennik Sagas.

achievements.name: Claus is Rising
achievements.desc: Claim a reward from Claus after doing him a favour.
achievements.tip: Hand in a cave wolf matriarch skull to Claus the chef after completion of Carnillean Rising. Players can obtain another skull after the quest by speaking with Claus the chef to re-enter the ominous portal and fight the cave wolf again. Players can choose between these selected rewards:

achievements.name: Crafting to Your Own Rune
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to runecraft masterwork 2h staves by making and upgrading to +5 a full set of eternal magic weaponry.
achievements.tip: Crafting to Your Own Rune is an achievement that requires making and imbuing nine specific magic weapons made from eternal magic logs. Completing this achievement unlocks the ability to create masterwork staves.

achievements.name: Da Vinci Who?
achievements.desc: Acquire knowledge from the listed ancient blueprints.
achievements.tip: Study the Ancient Invention blueprints.

achievements.name: Data Recovery
achievements.desc: Help the Archivist recover all core memory data in the Hall of Memories.
achievements.tip: Help the Archivist recover all core memory data in the Hall of Memories.

achievements.name: Deadlier Catch
achievements.desc: Hunt the Thalassus until it flees for good.
achievements.tip: Hunt the Thalassus another ten times after completion of Deadliest Catch. To begin these hunts, talk to Jones outside the bank in the Fishing Guild.

achievements.name: Diaries of the Clans
achievements.desc: Find the clan journal pages from the Hefin Agility Course in Prifddinas.
achievements.tip: Completely fill the Voice of the Elders by running laps on the Hefin Agility Course. One page is received every 20 laps, and a total of eight are needed to complete the book. Which page you get after every set of 20 laps is randomly determined.

achievements.name: Dinosaur Hunter
achievements.desc: Take down each dinosaur in Big Game Hunter.
achievements.tip: Take down each dinosaur in Big Game Hunter. Each dinosaur has to be killed just once for it to count against this achievement. A whole hour does not have to be done.

achievements.name: Draconic Decoctions
achievements.desc: Discover all of the listed potion recipes.
achievements.tip: Read all of the potion recipes listed below.

achievements.name: Elven Titles
achievements.desc: Obtain the titles of the elven clans.
achievements.tip: Obtain the clan-named elven titles after Plague's End in Prifddinas. You can see your progress on any of the titles by visiting the Customisations interface and looking at the Titles tab. The Elven titles are labelled under Miscellaneous Titles. Make sure that you have disabled filtering in the bottom left of the window in order to show titles you have not yet unlocked.

achievements.name: Everything Is Oresome
achievements.desc: Increase the capacity of your ore box by mining 100 of each of the listed ores.
achievements.tip: Mine 100 of each of the ores listed below. This includes mining light and dark animica rocks, which requires level 90 Mining. Completing the achievement increases the capacity of all ore boxes by 20 per ore (excluding platinum, gold and silver ore). Once the achievement is unlocked, the extra ore space can be used on free worlds, although membership is required to mine higher than runite ore.

achievements.name: Everything Is Still Oresome
achievements.desc: Increase the capacity of your ore box by mining 100 of each of the listed ores.
achievements.tip: Mine 100 of each of the below listed ores. Primal stone spirits can be used to accelerate the process, approximately halving the required number of times that ore must be mined. This achievement can also be done at the same time as attuning the pickaxe of earth and song using the spirit moonstone (rock), since the ores are not consumed as part of that process.

achievements.name: Everything Is Still Treemendous
achievements.desc: Increase the capacity of your wood box by cutting eternal magic logs.
achievements.tip: Cut 100 eternal magic logs from eternal magic trees, which requires level 100 Woodcutting. Completing the achievement increases the capacity of all wood boxes by 10 for logs, oak logs, willow logs, teak logs, maple logs, acadia logs, mahogany logs, yew logs, magic logs, elder logs, and eternal magic logs.

achievements.name: Everything Is Treemendous
achievements.desc: Increase the capacity of your wood box by cutting 100 of each of the listed logs.
achievements.tip: Cut 100 of each of the below listed logs, which requires level 90 Woodcutting. Completing the achievement increases the capacity of all wood boxes by 20 for logs, oak logs, willow logs, teak logs, maple logs, acadia logs, mahogany logs, yew logs, magic logs, elder logs, and eternal magic logs.

achievements.name: Family Spirit Tree
achievements.desc: Reconnect the Prifddinas spirit tree with her brethren.
achievements.tip: Plant the spirit tree in Brimhaven, Port Sarim, Etceteria, and Manor Farm before talking to Glouron to claim the Farming XP lamp. The third and fourth trees may only be planted after the first two trees have been health-checked and Glouron has been informed (which also completes Power of Three Spirits).

achievements.name: Famous
achievements.desc: Earn the title 'The Famous' by completing Morvran's Slayer challenge.
achievements.tip: Complete Morvran's special Slayer challenge and earn the title The Famous [Name].

achievements.name: Fletch Quest
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to fletch masterwork bows by making and upgrading to Mk. 5 a full set of primal/eternal magic ranged weaponry.
achievements.tip: Make and upgrade three types of ranged weaponry to Mk. 5 using eternal magic logs, bowstring, primal bars, and crossbow strings. Each of the following items must be made once to complete the achievement.

achievements.name: From Ardougne with Love
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the penguin spy device by tracking penguin spies around the world.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade the penguin spy device by tracking 40 penguin spies around the world.

achievements.name: Gaps, Traps and Laps
achievements.desc: Complete each of the listed agility courses at least once.
achievements.tip: Complete a lap on each of the listed Agility courses.

achievements.name: Gross Misconduct
achievements.desc: Slay an entire cohort of Zamorak's most powerful minions by killing 144 demons in the Wilderness.
achievements.tip: Kill 144 demons in the Wilderness.

achievements.name: Heal, Quickly
achievements.desc: Unlock the prayer 'Rapid Renewal' by purchasing the scroll of renewal from the Dungeoneering reward shop.
achievements.tip: Buy the Scroll of renewal from the Dungeoneering reward shop for 38,000 Dungeoneering tokens and reading it.

achievements.name: Here to Slay
achievements.desc: Equip a Corrupted Slayer Helmet, upgraded with an ensouled spectral lens.
achievements.tip: Equip a corrupted slayer helmet after consuming an ensouled spectral lens. It costs 2,500 slayer points to create a corrupted slayer helmet for the first time. The helmet may be created and worn at any point after consuming a lens to complete the achievement. If the lens is consumed prior to upgrading to the corrupted slayer helmet, the helmet must be removed and reequipped after the upgrade.

achievements.name: I'm Forever Washing Shadows
achievements.desc: Aid Lord Amlodd in cleansing shadow cores.
achievements.tip: Obtain the 50,000 Divination XP lamp by speaking to Lord Amlodd after cleansing 15 each of truthful, blissful, and manifest shadow cores obtained from the appropriate shadow creatures.

achievements.name: I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests)
achievements.page: I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests)
achievements.desc: Complete all miniquests listed in the Quests interface. Does not include sagas.
achievements.tip: Complete the listed miniquests.

achievements.name: Imping Around
achievements.desc: Collect one of each impling for Daffyd in Prifddinas.
achievements.tip: Catch one of each type of impling for Daffyd after speaking to him.

achievements.name: In Rituals We Trust
achievements.desc: Perform every core ritual.
achievements.tip: Perform all of the listed rituals at least once.

achievements.name: Invention Gives Me the Blues
achievements.desc: Purchase all of the blueprints for the Invention Technology devices.
achievements.tip: Buy all the blueprints in the dwarven and cave goblin technology trees.

achievements.name: It Should Have Been Called Aetherium
achievements.page: It Should Have Been Called Aetherium
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to smith masterwork armour by making and upgrading to +5 a full set of elder rune armour.
achievements.tip: It Should Have Been Called Aetherium is an achievement completed by making and upgrading a full set of elder rune armour to + 5. This requires a full set of elder rune armour + 4 (helm, platebody, platelegs, gauntlets, and boots) and 192 elder rune bars, or a total of 384 elder rune bars if making the set from scratch. This would cost 7,769,865 coins if purchasing the + 4 items and bars or 5,682,048 coins if purchasing just bars.

achievements.name: It Should Have Been Called Ancestral
achievements.page: It Should Have Been Called Ancestral
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to craft masterwork magic armour by making and upgrading to +5 a full set of starbloom armour.
achievements.tip: It Should Have Been Called Ancestral is an achievement completed by making and upgrading a full set of Starbloom equipment to + 5. Upgrading all single pieces from + 4 to + 5 will unlock this achievement. Completing this achievement corresponds to unlocking the ability to craft masterwork magic robes.

achievements.name: It Should Have Been Called Chinskin
achievements.page: It Should Have Been Called Chinskin
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to craft masterwork ranged armour by making and upgrading to +5 a full set of apex hide armour.
achievements.tip: Make and upgrade a full set of apex hide armour to +5. Upgrading all single pieces from +4 to +5 will unlock this achievement. Completing this achievement corresponds to unlocking the ability to craft masterwork ranged equipment.

achievements.name: It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium
achievements.page: It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium
achievements.desc: Unlock the ability to smith masterwork swords by making and upgrading to +5 a full set of primal armour.
achievements.tip: It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium is an achievement completed by making and upgrading the primal armour pieces listed below to their +5 variants. This requires the +4 variants of the items and 192 primal bars, or a total of 384 primal bars if making the set from scratch. This would cost 16,068,736 coins if purchasing an armour set + 4 or 8,805,120 coins if purchasing just bars.

achievements.name: Kiln Fighter
achievements.desc: Complete the Fight Kiln.
achievements.tip: Finish the Fight Kiln once.

achievements.name: Kudos to You
achievements.desc: Reach full Kudos with the Varrock Museum.
achievements.tip: Obtain all available Kudos by helping out the Varrock Museum. To check remaining Kudos points to gain, speak with the information clerk in the north west corner of the museum.

achievements.name: Long Live the Queen
achievements.desc: Defeat the Queen Black Dragon and obtain the first dragonkin journal.
achievements.tip: Obtain the first dragonkin journal as drop from the first kill of the Queen Black Dragon.

achievements.name: Lunar Master
achievements.desc: Unlock all lunar spells.
achievements.tip: Lunar Master is an achievement that tracks the player's progress into unlocking the eleven Livid Farm spells. The spells must be unlocked in order. The player must be on the Lunar spellbook to complete the tasks on the farm.

achievements.name: Make Them Bleed
achievements.desc: Perform well enough in Rush of Blood to impress Morvran.
achievements.tip: Clear wave 20 of any difficulty of Rush of Blood, then claim the Slayer XP lamp from Morvran by talking to him either inside or outside the arena.

achievements.name: Master Skiller
achievements.desc: Increase all skills to mastery level.
achievements.tip: Master Skiller is an achievement that tracks the player's progress towards skill levels needed for the completionist cape.

achievements.name: Maximum Poolpulation
achievements.desc: Reach the maximum number of fish in each pool at the Wendlewick fish farm with all four pools active.
achievements.tip: Reach the maximum number of fish in each pool at the Wendlewick fish farm with all four pools active.

achievements.name: Memories of Guthix
achievements.desc: Attune and hand all engrams in to the Memorial to Guthix.
achievements.tip: Complete the Memorial to Guthix at least once by collecting all engrams, charging them, and handing them in to Orla Fairweather. Players need to complete the tutorial with Orla Fairweather first in order to be able to pick up the engrams.

achievements.name: Minor Wisdom
achievements.desc: Earn the Wisdom of Anima fletching perk for one of the Elder God arrow types.
achievements.tip: Unlock one of the Wisdom of Anima perks for Elder God arrows (a Fletching benefit) after upgrading the Ranger's Workroom at Fort Forinthry to Tier 3.

achievements.name: Music Maestro
achievements.desc: Unlock all music tracks.
achievements.tip: Music Maestro is an achievement that tracks the number of music tracks the player has unlocked out of the current total of 1,405. However, the following four tracks are not required to complete this achievement:

achievements.name: My Last Resort
achievements.desc: Unlock the mentioned amenities in War's Retreat.
achievements.tip: Unlock the following unlocks at War's Wares. This requires a total of 2,000 boss kills.

achievements.name: Myreque in Memoriam
achievements.desc: Complete construction of the Myreque memorial and help Veliaf to move on.
achievements.tip: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz after the completion of the In Memory of the Myreque miniquest and the River of Blood quest.

achievements.name: Mystical Moonstone
achievements.desc: Learn how to craft moonstone jewellery.
achievements.tip: Learn how to craft moonstone jewellery from the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um.

achievements.name: No Need to Pikkenchoose
achievements.desc: Unlock everything from Pikkenflix's Shrine of the Spirit Wolf shop south of Wendlewick.
achievements.tip: Unlock everything from the Shrine of the Spirit Wolves shop run by Pikkenflix south of Wendlewick.

achievements.name: Out into the Ourania
achievements.desc: Unlock the spell: Ourania Teleport.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Ourania Teleport spell by talking to Baba Yaga with the Lunar spellbook active after completion of Lunar Diplomacy.

achievements.name: Peachy Bones
achievements.desc: Unlock the spell: Bones to Peaches.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Bones To Peaches spell from the Mage Training Arena. The cost of unlocking the spell varies depending on which Desert achievements the player has completed:

achievements.name: Pious Prayers
achievements.desc: By completing the 8 Knight Waves in Camelot, unlock the prayers: Chivalry, Piety, Rigour, Augury.
achievements.tip: Unlock Chivalry, Piety, Rigour, and Augury by completing the Knight Waves training ground after King's Ransom.

achievements.name: Port Life
achievements.desc: Complete the Player Owned Port tutorial.

oneOf.text: 90 Agility or 90 Construction or 90 Cooking or 90 Divination or 90 Dungeoneering or 90 Fishing or 90 Herblore or 90 Hunter or 90 Prayer or 90 Runecrafting or 90 Slayer or 90 Thieving

achievements.tip: Follow the Player-owned port tutorial after getting level 90 in either one of Agility, Construction, Cooking, Divination, Dungeoneering, Fishing, Herblore, Hunter, Prayer, Runecrafting, Slayer, or Thieving.

achievements.name: Potion For a Lady
achievements.desc: Help Lady Meilyr to retrieve her lost potion recipes.
achievements.tip: Find one unreadable page in Daemonheim and give Lady Meilyr a self-made super melee potion in exchange for the melee XP lamp.

achievements.name: Potion Mixer Master I
achievements.desc: Unlock the listed combination potion recipes from Clan Meilyr in Prifddinas.
achievements.tip: Collect the listed combination potions by either buying the recipe in the Recipe Shop or finding unreadable pages in Daemonheim and then buying it. The total cost of unlocking all listed potions is 12,500,000 coins.

achievements.name: Potion Mixer Master II
achievements.desc: Unlock the listed advanced combination potion recipes from Clan Meilyr in Prifddinas.
achievements.tip: Collect the listed advanced combination potions by buying the recipe in the Recipe Shop accessed through either Lady Meilyr or a harmony pillar farmer who are located in the Meilyr Clan district in north-eastern Prifddinas.

achievements.name: Power Planter II
achievements.desc: Unlock Plant Power (Tier 4) from Sydekix's Reward Store at the Garden of Kharid.
achievements.tip: Unlock the Plant Power (Tier 4) reward for a cumulative total of 33,950 Crux Eqal favour at Sydekix's Shop of Balance in the Garden of Kharid.

achievements.name: Qualification - Guildmaster
achievements.desc: Complete all of the listed achievements and attend the qualification ceremony.
achievements.tip: Complete specific achievements. Despite the achievement's description, talking to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger at the Archaeology Guild to become a guildmaster is not required.

achievements.name: Quest Cape
achievements.desc: Complete all quests to obtain the quest cape.

links.name: A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains
A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen
A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift
Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf
Once Upon a Time in Gielinor

achievements.tip: Quest Cape is an achievement that is requires the player to complete all quests to be able to obtain the Quest Cape.

achievements.name: Rhian in Gold - The Original
achievements.desc: Fully build the statue of Rhiannon in the Tower of Voices at least once.
achievements.tip: Collect all of the golden rocks and building the statue of Rhiannon once.

achievements.name: Seren Memories
achievements.desc: Deposit Seren memoriam crystals (from the Approach of Freneskae), then search the Sanctum alcove.
achievements.tip: Deposit all four of Seren memoriam crystals to the memoriam device and claim the Crest of Seren override from the storage in the Sanctum on Freneskae after the quest Fate of the Gods.

achievements.name: Sing for the Lady
achievements.desc: Help Lady Ithell with crystal singing research.
achievements.tip: Claim the magic XP lamp from Lady Ithell by using the following items on her one at a time: crystal staff, crystal orb, crystal wand and crystal ward. After using an item on her, a crystal weapon seed or a crystal armour seed of the relevant type is immediately given back. Used weapons cannot be provided; the weapons must be at 100% charge. They can be crafted from crystal seeds or purchased from the Grand Exchange. After this exchange occurs, speak with Lady Ithell once more to obtain the lamp and complete the achievement. ( 4)…

achievements.name: Slayer Master
achievements.desc: Earn the title 'Slayer Master' from Morvran's platinum Rush of Blood challenge.
achievements.tip: Complete wave twenty of the platinum difficulty of Rush of Blood and earning the title Slayer Master [Name]. Twenty waves need to be cleared; reaching wave 20 does not suffice.

achievements.name: Slide To The Left
achievements.desc: Solve a puzzle box.
achievements.tip: Solve a puzzle box from Treasure Trails.

achievements.name: Stacks on Stacks
achievements.desc: Place a totem on Anachronia.
other: 81 Woodcutting or find an overgrown idol cleared by another player
achievements.tip: Place a totem on Anachronia.

achievements.name: Stay Safe
achievements.desc: Fully complete the Stronghold of Player Safety.
achievements.tip: Obtain the rewards of the chest at the end of the Stronghold of Player Safety. Pull an old lever on the upper floor of the stronghold, then enter the secure area and loot the treasure chest.

achievements.name: Stay Secure
achievements.desc: Fully complete the Stronghold of Security.
achievements.tip: Obtain the rewards from the Gift of Peace, Grain of Plenty, Box of Health and Cradle of Life within the Stronghold of Security.

achievements.name: Student Becomes the Master
achievements.desc: Learn all of Kili's equipment upgrade tasks.
achievements.tip: Learn all of Kili's gear upgrades by completing the following achievements.

achievements.name: Talented in Necromancy
achievements.desc: Unlock every Talent from the Well of Souls.
achievements.tip: Unlock all talents.

achievements.name: Task Master
achievements.desc: Complete all the listed area achievement sets.
achievements.tip: Task Master is an achievement that tracks the player's progress into completing all Area Tasks achievements.

achievements.name: The Crocodile Hunter
achievements.desc: Unlock all non-cosmetic Hunter upgrades from Dundee's Shop.
achievements.tip: Unlock all non-cosmetic Hunter upgrades from the Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades shop, requiring a total of 3,000 scarabs to be caught at Het's Oasis (stacked scarabs also count towards this total). Unlocking the golden crocodile cosmetic upgrade for an additional 2,000 scarabs caught is a requirement for The Golden Crocodile Hunter achievement.

achievements.name: The Greatest Gift of All
achievements.desc: Learn a lesson from Lea outside the Invention Guild.
achievements.tip: First give Lea a new pickpocketing bag and then a new crystal binding rod.

achievements.name: Tiers of Treasure
achievements.desc: Complete 1 clue of each tier.
achievements.tip: Complete each tier of clue scroll at least once.

achievements.name: Top Town Hall
achievements.desc: Fully upgrade the Town Hall in the base camp on Anachronia.
achievements.tip: Fully upgrade the Town Hall on Anachronia.

achievements.name: Towering Over Us All
achievements.desc: Solve a Towers puzzle.
achievements.tip: Solve a towers puzzle scroll (master). Using a tower skipping ticket will not work.

achievements.name: Trip to the East
achievements.desc: Complete one of the trio storylines from your Player Owned Port.

oneOf.text: 90 Fishing + 90 Runecrafting + 90 Slayer or 90 Herblore + 90 Prayer + 90 Thieving or 90 Construction + 90 Cooking + 90 Hunter or 90 Agility + 90 Divination + 90 Dungeoneering

achievements.tip: Complete one of the trio storylines in the player-owned port, Quin, Hyu-Ji, Eastern Curiosities or Guardians of the World.

achievements.name: Troublesome Crystals
achievements.desc: Find all of the memoriam crystals in Prifddinas.

links.name: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

achievements.tip: Collect all 16 Prifddinas memoriam crystals after Plague's End, not including the unknown crystal. The player then has to deposit the crystals in the Prifddinas memoriam device, located in the Tower of Voices.

achievements.name: Uncorrupted Ore
achievements.desc: Aid Lady Trahaearn in removing some corruption by smelting 100 corrupted ore.
achievements.tip: Smelt 100 corrupted ore in the Trahaearn Clan furnace, and then claiming the Smithing XP lamp from Lady Trahaearn.

achievements.name: Undead to Rites
achievements.desc: Teleport to the Ungael ritual site using the Ungael Teleport incantation.
achievements.tip: Teleport to the Ungael ritual site using the Ungael Teleport incantation.

achievements.name: Unliving on a Prayer
achievements.desc: Unlock all of the listed prayers from Selene.
achievements.tip: Unlock all Necromancy prayers and Ancient Curses from Selene in the City of Um, with the exception of Ruination.

achievements.name: Unlocking Waiko I
achievements.desc: Purchase unlocks from the Waiko reward shop.
achievements.tip: Purchase the unlocks from the Waiko Reward Shop from the list below for a total cost of 7750 chimes and 5 taijitu.

achievements.name: Untangled
achievements.desc: Solve a celtic knot.
achievements.tip: Solve a celtic knot from Treasure Trails.

achievements.name: Upgrading Waiko I
achievements.desc: Purchase the first tier of upgrades in the Waiko reward shop.
achievements.tip: Purchase the first tier of the upgrades listed below from the Waiko Reward Shop for a total cost of 17,000 chimes and 16 taijitu.

achievements.name: Walking the Reef
achievements.desc: Find all reefwalker's cape scroll pieces in Player Owned Ports.

oneOf.text: 90 Agility or 90 Construction or 90 Cooking or 90 Divination or 90 Dungeoneering or 90 Fishing or 90 Herblore or 90 Hunter or 90 Prayer or 90 Runecrafting or 90 Slayer or 90 Thieving

achievements.tip: Find all four eastern scroll pieces of the reefwalker's cape within the player-owned port.

achievements.name: What's Mine is Also Doric's
achievements.desc: Complete all of the Doric and Boric tasks.
achievements.tip: Complete the Doric's Tasks quest series and Boric's Tasks quest series after completion of What's Mine is Yours.

achievements.name: Whodunnit? I Dunnit!
achievements.desc: Complete the Ungael combat activity on standard mode.
achievements.tip: Complete the standard mode encounter of the Ungael combat activity. Completing this achievement is a requirement for the Completionist Cape achievement.

achievements.name: Yaktwee's a Charm
achievements.desc: Unlock the enhanced Yaktwee stick by catching charm sprites.
achievements.tip: Catch 1,000 charm sprites with the yaktwee stick to unlock the enhanced yaktwee stick.

achievements.name: Zarosian Memories
achievements.desc: Deposit Zarosian memoriam crystals, then search the Sanctum alcove.
achievements.tip: Deposit all twelve of Zarosian memoriam crystals to the memoriam device and claim the Helm of Zaros override from the storage in the Sanctum on Freneskae after the quest Fate of the Gods.
